risk_if_not_implemented: Without Contingency Planning Components, critical business processes and services may not withstand or recover from disruption, causing extended outages and data loss. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unaddressed Security / Compliance Exposure (R-GV-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Data Quality Degradation / Data Poisoning (MT-12).

compensating_control_1.name: Risk Assessment
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to conduct recurring assessments of risk that includes the likelihood and magnitude of harm, from unauthorized access, use, disclosure, disruption, modification or destruction of the organization's Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD).
compensating_control_1.justification: Risk Assessment (RSK-13) provides periodic assessment and assurance that compensates for the absence of Contingency Planning Components (BCD-07.1) by providing structured evaluation of the environment to surface gaps and verify residual control effectiveness. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Business Continuity Management System (BCMS)
compensating_control_2.description:
Mechanisms exist to operate a Business Continuity Management System (BCMS) to achieve resilient Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) during:
(1) Routine operations; and
(2) Adverse conditions.
compensating_control_2.justification: Business Continuity Management System (BCMS) (BCD-02) provides resilience and recovery capability that compensates for the absence of Contingency Planning Components (BCD-07.1) by ensuring the organization can restore operations and data when the primary control is absent. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
